question: A man goes 12 km North, turns East and walks 5km, turns South and walks 3 km, then turns West and walks 5km. How far is he from the starting point?
solution:
Given:

A man goes 12 km North,

Turns East and walks 5km,

Turns South and walks 3 km,

Then turns West and walks 5km.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a77606c86f37ad3e80f077cfe7f7c73d4e974790829437b60e5243b3e39d6360.png] 

So, he is 9 km from the starting point.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
